backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for a Hyperliquid trade analyzer, including types for trade positions, risk levels, fee analysis, and analysis sessions, with functions to store and retrieve analysis sessions and compute metals PnL.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping implemented feature IDs to their titles, associated source files, component dependencies, and test IDs, covering the Trade Entry Checker tab, frontend rule engine, and failed-condition explanations.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, and utility libraries.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app, setting the page title to 'Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer' and mounting the app via the #root div and main.tsx module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing global state (analysis data, selected asset, active tab) and rendering a four-tab layout (Trade Analysis, Trade Entry Checker, Orderbook Heatmap, Help/FAQ) with error fallback UIs.
Displays parsed CSV trade analysis results in a scrollable layout with summary cards, charts, a positions table, asset selector, and fee overview, supporting CSV export and asset filtering.
frontend/src/components/AssetSelector.ts: A React component that renders a filterable asset selector card with search input and grouped dropdown (metals, stablecoins, cryptos), displaying stats for the selected asset and allowing the user to reset the filter.
frontend/src/components/ChartsSection.ts: Renders multiple Recharts visualizations (bar and pie charts) for trade PnL, direction distribution, liquidation status, long/short split, and per-asset PnL, with click-through asset selection support.
frontend/src/components/EntryChecklistRe: Displays a trade entry evaluation result as a summary card with a GO/WAIT/NO-GO verdict badge and a detailed checklist of individual conditions with pass/fail icons.
frontend/src/components/FeeOverview.tsx: A comprehensive fee analysis component that computes and visualizes trading fees by asset, direction, and category, highlights high-fee trades, and provides optimization recommendations using charts and tabbed views.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: A simple footer component displaying a copyright notice with a heart icon, a link to caffeine.ai, and the app version string.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: A sticky top header component showing the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer branding with a gradient icon and subtitle.
frontend/src/components/HelpFaq.tsx: An accordion-based FAQ page explaining differences between Hyperliquid Testnet and Mainnet (prices, liquidity, oracles) and providing troubleshooting guidance for the trading simulator.
frontend/src/components/orderbook/Orderb: React component that renders an animated orderbook heatmap on an HTML canvas, smoothly interpolating between bid/ask data updates using requestAnimationFrame with a configurable transition duration based on the update interval.
frontend/src/components/OrderbookHeatmap: React component that renders a live Hyperliquid orderbook heatmap with controls for symbol, depth, update interval, rendering mode (bars/cluster), and pause/refresh functionality. Uses the useHyperliquidOrderbook hook and delegates canvas rendering to OrderbookHeatmapCanvas.
frontend/src/components/PositionsTable.t: Displays a sortable, expandable table of trade positions grouped into metals, stablecoins, and other assets, with sorting by newest/oldest/feeAlpha and color-coded leverage and risk indicators.
frontend/src/components/SummaryCards.tsx: Renders a grid of summary stat cards (total positions, liquidations, PnL, metals PnL, stablecoins PnL) that adapt to a selected asset filter using computed trade summary data.
frontend/src/components/TradeEntryChecke: Form component that collects technical indicator inputs (price, EMAs, RSI, ATR, MACD, direction) and evaluates trade entry conditions, displaying validation errors and scrolling to a checklist results component on submission.
frontend/src/components/UploadSection.ts: Drag-and-drop CSV upload component that validates, parses, and passes Hyperliquid trade data to the parent via a callback, with error handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing access control on authentication and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHyperliquidOrderbo: Custom React hook that polls the Hyperliquid API for orderbook data at a configurable interval, falling back to a backend actor if the direct fetch fails, and returns parsed bids, asks, and mid price.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and provider for ICP, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context backed by DFINITY's AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for CRUD operations on analysis sessions and trade data, including fetching sessions by user/ID and a mutation for storing sessions with computed per-asset statistics.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that imports Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme design tokens including colors, borders, and chart variables.
frontend/src/lib/csvExporter.ts: Exports trade position analysis data to a CSV file with German column headers, including fee alpha metrics and asset category labels, triggering a browser download.
frontend/src/lib/csvParser.ts: Parses CSV files containing trade position data, supporting German and English column names as well as Hyperliquid-specific formats, and maps rows to typed TradePosition objects.
frontend/src/lib/feeAlpha.ts: Computes and aggregates Fee Alpha metrics for trade positions, classifying fees as Captured, Paid, or Neutral and providing grouping utilities by asset and direction.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidMarkets.ts: Defines a static list of supported Hyperliquid market symbols and provides helper functions for validation, sanitization, and retrieving a default market.
frontend/src/lib/hyperliquidOrderbook.ts: Parses and validates raw Hyperliquid orderbook data into a structured format with typed bid/ask levels and a computed mid-price.
frontend/src/lib/orderbookHeatmapRenderi: Provides canvas rendering utilities for orderbook heatmap visualization, including normalization, interpolation with easing, color generation, and cumulative depth calculation.
frontend/src/lib/tradeEntryRules.ts: Defines and evaluates trade entry conditions (EMA alignment, RSI, MACD, price extension) for Long and Short directions, returning a verdict and per-condition pass/fail details.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Utility functions for CSS class merging, currency formatting, status/risk label and color mapping, asset categorization (metals, stablecoins), and position filtering helpers used throughout the frontend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading URL query parameters (supporting both regular and hash-based routing), persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining OKLCH-based design tokens (colors, border radius, shadows, animations) and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest describing the Hyperliquid Trade Analyzer app's architecture, existing features, known issues, and versioning metadata for build planning and AI context.
